prey
音标：英 /preɪ/  美 /pre/
vi. 猎取食物
n. 猎物， 捕获物；受害者

短语：bird of prey — 猛禽；食肉鸟

例句：The effect was to disrupt the food chain, starving many animals and those that preyed on them.

tug
音标：英 /tʌg/  美 /tʌɡ/
v. 用力拖
n. 猛拉； 牵引 <；拖船

例句：She removed the bandage with a sharp tug.
她猛地一拉，扯下绷带。
